hero.name: Likith G
hero.intro: AIML engineering student focused on building practical ML and deep learning solutions.

paragraphs: I'm Likith G, an Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning engineering student who enjoys building practical solutions using machine learning, deep learning, and NLP.
I like working on end-to-end projects—from data preparation and model building to creating a simple interface that makes the solution usable.
My recent work includes Resume Detection using Generative AI with sentiment analysis, and Rice Crop Disease Detection using deep learning for early identification from images.
I'm actively improving my skills in deep learning, computer vision, and deploying ML projects, and I'm open to internships and collaborative opportunities.

projects.lead: A few projects I've built recently.

items.title: Resume Detection using Generative AI & Sentiment Analysis
items.description: Built a system to analyze resumes using Generative AI techniques and sentiment analysis to extract insights and improve screening quality.

items.title: Rice Crop Disease Detection using Deep Learning
items.description: Developed a deep learning model to detect rice crop diseases from images to support early identification and improve crop health outcomes.
